ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
title: Last Date for Nominations for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026 Extended till 15th August
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Last Date for Nominations for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar 2026 Extended till 15th August

Nomination process is through the National Awards Portal https://awards.gov.in ⁠

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
31 JUL 2026 2:03PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Women and Child Development has extended the last date for submission of online nominations, which had been earlier fixed as 31
st
 July 2026 to 15
th
 August 2026. The nomination process for the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar (PMRBP) commenced on 01
st
 April, 2026 through the National Awards Portal (
https://awards.gov.in
).

The awards are conferred on children who have demonstrated exceptional achievements in the fields of Bravery, Social Service, Environment, Sports, Arts & Culture, and Science & Technology.

Any child who is an Indian citizen residing in India, is above 5 years of age and not exceeding 18 years of age (as on 31st July, 2026), is eligible for the awards. Nominations, including self-nominations and recommendations by any citizen, shall be accepted only through the National Awards Portal.

For further details, please visit the National Awards Portal at
https://awards.gov.in⁠
.
